name: Vermont Watershed Grant Program
summary: Small annual grants for local projects that protect or restore Vermont's lakes, ponds, rivers and streams, from on-the-ground work to monitoring and outreach. Towns, nonprofits and citizen groups can lead.

amount.note: Up to $10,000 for on-the-ground work; $3,500 for planning and monitoring; $5,000 for outreach

eligibility.rule: Not an individual or a state or federal agency

status.quote: The 2026 Project Year grant application deadline is February 4, 2026.

deadline.quote: The 2026 Project Year grant application deadline is February 4, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Municipalities, local or regional governmental agencies, nonprofit organizations, and citizen groups are eligible to receive Watershed Grants for work on public or private lands.

geography.quote: the Vermont Watershed Grant Program has supported the protection, restoration, enhancement, and public appreciation of Vermont's lakes, ponds, rivers, and streams.

access.quote: Persons interested in applying should consult and use the following project year forms:

window.quote: Grant awards are made on an annual cycle, with applications due in the fall of the year and funding decisions made the following mid-winter.

amount.quote: Awards are made up to $10,000, depending on the project category type.

eligibility.quote: Individuals and state and federal agencies are not eligible to receive funds directly but may be partners of a project.
